connections.description: The three apps exchange data over their APIs with personal access tokens.
connections.nutritionFromCookingHint: Use CookTrace recipes as meals and its pantry as foods.

scopes.nt: A CookTrace API token (ct_pat_…) with read:recipes, and read:pantry for the pantry.
scopes.ct: A NutriTrace API token (nt_pat_…) with read:foods.
scopes.lt: A NutriTrace API token (nt_pat_…) with write:workouts.

connections.missingRecipeScope: The token works but lacks the read:recipes scope.
connections.importRecipesText: Every CookTrace recipe is imported into your NutriTrace recipes. Running it again overwrites earlier imports, also ones you edited in NutriTrace.
connections.importPantryText: Pantry items and variants become foods. Generic items that have variants are left out. Safe to run again.
connections.collided_one: {{count}} was already in the library (same barcode) and stayed as it was.
connections.collided_other: {{count}} were already in the library (same barcode) and stayed as they were.
connections.cookingFromNutritionHint: Look up NutriTrace foods from CookTrace.
connections.genericName: Name of the new generic item
connections.trainingToNutritionHint: Finished workouts count as calories burned in NutriTrace.
connections.needsCalories: Turn on “Estimate calories burned” in the workout settings; without it there is nothing to send.
connections.wearableWins: On days with wearable data, NutriTrace prefers the wearable.

pantryRefused.scope: The CookTrace token lacks the read:pantry scope. Create one on CookTrace with read:pantry and paste it here.
pantryRefused.oldServer: This CookTrace server is too old to share its pantry. Update CookTrace and try again.
pantryRefused.token: CookTrace rejected the token. Create a new one and paste it here.
